data.title: PEARL Price Falls More Than 35% in 10 Days as Hashrate Declines and Mining Returns Diverge
data.description: PEARL’s price fell more than 35% over 10 days, alongside a decline in network hashrate and per-card mining revenue. According to PANews, the lag between price movements and network difficulty adjustments has squeezed miners’ returns, with newer entrants more likely to lose money. Home miners who have already paid for hardware may remain profitable if they only cover electricity costs, while some large-scale mining operations are shifting to AI services after weighing the opportunity cost. Short-term cloud-computing renters have been the first to exit, while miners with longer-term contracts are staying. More than 90% of the network’s hashrate is not performing actual AI computations, and daily token issuance adds potential selling pressure; early tokens without lockups and a mining pool controlling nearly half the hashrate are also cited as risks. PEARL’s future depends on whether it can attract real demand for AI inference.

data.title: Trump Criticized Big Oil Profits as Refining Earnings Surged
data.description: According to CNBC, President Donald Trump criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron in August, saying they were making too much money amid a shortage as profits climbed after the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran. Shell, BP, TotalEnergies and Exxon reported sharply higher refining margins this week. Chevron said Friday that its downstream earnings more than quadrupled from a year earlier to $4.9 billion, citing higher margins on refined-product sales.

data.title: StonkBrokers Founder Says Official Website Was Not Attacked as Blockaid Withdraws Alert
data.description: StonkBrokers founder SimpleFarmer said on X that a security alert about a StepDrainer frontend attack on the company was a false positive; the flagged malicious domain was not the official website, StonkBrokers.io. According to Odaily, Blockaid removed StonkBrokers from its list of affected sites and deleted its warning post. The team also took the malicious domain offline.

data.title: Flap Moves to Flap.cool, Warns Users Against Using Old Domain
data.description: Flap has moved to flap.cool and advised users not to visit flap.sh, connect wallets, or sign transactions on the old domain. According to ChainCatcher, Flap said on X that the migration was intended to protect users and ensure stable platform operations.

data.title: Bitdeer Maintains Zero Bitcoin Holdings After Selling 265.5 BTC This Week
data.description: Bitdeer said it sold all 265.5 BTC produced this week, with no net change in its holdings. According to Odaily, as of October 30, Bitdeer held zero BTC, excluding customer deposits.

data.title: Paul Chan Says Hong Kong’s 2026 Growth May Be Strongest in Five Years
data.description: Hong Kong’s economy grew robustly in the third quarter, paving the way for what may be its strongest annual expansion in five years, Financial Secretary Paul Chan said, according to Bloomberg, citing Radio Television Hong Kong.

data.title: Flap Team Member Jason Says Contracts, Token Creation, Treasury and Lockups Are Unaffected
data.description: Flap team member Jason said user funds are secure and that contracts, token creation, treasury operations and lockups are unaffected. According to Odaily, he advised anyone who visited a counterfeit website between 9:00 and 13:00 (UTC+8) and connected a wallet or signed a transaction to message him privately or contact the Flap team. People who are unsure whether they were affected or have questions can also contact the team for assistance with checking and addressing the issue.

data.title: SpaceX (SPCX.O) Confirms Deployment of 27 Starlink Satellites
data.description: According to Jin10, SpaceX (SPCX.O) confirmed that it deployed 27 Starlink satellites.

data.title: Ansem Says Time Is a Key Risk-Management Factor in Short-Term Trading
data.description: Crypto trader Ansem shared his approach to managing risk in short-term trades. According to ChainCatcher, he said traders should consider time—not just price and stop-loss levels—when assessing whether a trade is working. When he enters a trade, he expects a clear market move to develop quickly; if Bitcoin stays near his entry price for an extended period without moving as anticipated, he reassesses the trade. He may exit early if the expected move fails to materialize, even if his stop-loss has not been triggered. Ansem said short-term trading can help traders identify sooner whether a strategy is working, and that deciding whether to hold a trade should take into account how long the market takes to meet expectations as well as its price action.

data.title: AI Agents Could Book the Wrong Flight, Raising Payment Liability Questions
data.description: Daniel Ishag, Bakkt’s chief commercial officer, described a hypothetical in which an AI agent books a flight to North Korea instead of South Korea, highlighting the risks of letting software spend autonomously. BeInCrypto’s State of AI Agent Payments 2026 found 14 of 19 reviewed products and workflows could act within preapproved permissions, according to BeInCrypto, while two incidents examined in the report sent $281,200 to attackers before recoveries. Stripe’s Link terms make users responsible for connected-agent transactions, including unintended ones, except in cases of Stripe’s own technical failure or error.

data.title: Polymarket’s Senate Swing-State Republican Victory Market Gives “No” Option the Lead at 24.5%
data.description: The “Republicans Win in Senate Swing States” market on Polymarket currently gives the “No” option the highest probability, at about 24.5%. According to ChainCatcher, the market’s total pool has reached $5.15 million, and trading activity ranks among the platform’s highest.

data.title: Kintsu Confirms DNS Hijacking, Urges Users to Revoke Permissions and Move Assets
data.description: Kintsu said its official website was affected by a DNS hijacking incident involving its domain registrar and is displaying a malicious site. According to Odaily, the project warned users not to visit the site, connect their wallets, or sign transactions. Users who connected a wallet or signed a transaction since 00:00 UTC on October 31 should revoke related permissions through the Revoke platform and transfer their assets. Kintsu said it will issue another notice after confirming the website is secure.

data.title: Why Did the US Stock Market Crash? $2 Trillion Wiped Out
data.description: Wall Street's October selloff erased roughly $2 trillion from Nasdaq-100 market value as investors questioned whether AI returns can justify heavy spending. Disappointing tech earnings, slowing-growth warnings, elevated valuations, rising inflation and expectations of a Fed rate increase in December intensified pressure, according to BeInCrypto. Intel plunged nearly 29% Friday after a factory disruption and weak forecast; Reddit fell more than 36% for the week as AI-generated search answers cut traffic, while Alphabet lost more than $500 billion in market value Thursday. Amazon expects about $220 billion in capital expenditure this year. The article describes the selloff as an AI valuation correction, not conclusive evidence of a bursting bubble; upcoming AMD and Nvidia results could clarify demand.

data.title: StepDrainer Attacks Expand to More DeFi Projects as Blockaid Advises Users Against Connecting Wallets
data.description: Blockaid has warned that StepDrainer attacks previously targeting Kintsu and Flap are expanding to StonkFun, Pickle Finance, Echelon, Origami, Fluxbeam, Stakepoint, SupSwap, Longbow, SHPRD and ApeX DeFi. According to Odaily, Pons founder Ozzy said in a post on X that Blockaid advises users to avoid the listed websites and previously identified affected decentralized applications, and not to connect their wallets.

data.title: Address Closes 25x Leveraged ETH Short After Five Days, Nets $692,000
data.description: An address closed a 25x leveraged ETH short after five days, recording a profit of $692,000. According to ChainCatcher, citing on-chain analyst Ai Yi, the address had opened the short at an average price of $2,311.92, holding 9,700 ETH. It closed the position at an average price of $2,239.50 at 18:33 yesterday, during a rebound after ETH pulled back; its floating profit had briefly reached $1.337 million, and its total account profit rose to $7.57 million.

data.title: Two Addresses Sell About 1.21 Million HYPE, Make More Than $26.5 Million
data.description: Two addresses recently sold about 1.21 million HYPE, earning a combined profit of more than $26.5 million. According to Foresight News, Lookonchain monitored the transactions: an address beginning with 0x2685 sold 912,383 HYPE 6 hours ago, making more than $10 million after buying the tokens one month ago. An address beginning with 0x648F sold 296,705 HYPE 8 hours ago, earning $16.5 million after purchasing the tokens 11 months ago.

data.title: Vitalik Says Digital Minimalism Can Reduce Reliance on Social Media and the Internet in the AI Era
data.description:
Vitalik shared an essay titled “Digital Minimalism” on X, arguing that people should reconsider their relationship with digital tools as AI develops. According to Odaily, he said users should decide when and how to use digital services rather than be guided by social media algorithms, mobile internet and complex website interfaces.

Vitalik described three steps he has taken: using Firefly to manage X, Bluesky, Farcaster and Lens instead of relying on X’s native interface; keeping his phone in airplane mode by default for 100 consecutive days and connecting through Wi-Fi only when needed; and using command-line tools for tasks involving ENS, IPFS and privacy protocols rather than completing them through websites.

He said traditional websites and web applications can pose privacy risks and require users to trust their servers each time they visit. In his view, modular tools, local applications and AI can let people use natural language to perform tasks that previously required programming knowledge, reducing reliance on closed platforms and complex interfaces. He called the approach “digital minimalism” and said advances in AI, offline applications and software tools are making it possible to rely less on social media, the internet and web applications.

data.title: Flap Founder Says Risk Is Limited to Users Who Connected Wallets or Signed Approvals on Rogue Site
data.description:
Flap’s founder addressed the impact of an incident involving an irregularity with the project’s official website domain. According to ChainCatcher, the risk is limited to users who visited the abnormal site in the tens of minutes before the announcement and connected a wallet or signed an authorization. Users who had previously connected to the FLAP website normally are unaffected and do not need to change their wallet addresses.

The founder said FLAP does not store users’ private keys, seed phrases, or wallet data on its backend. Users should avoid the official website until the issue is resolved; the team will announce when it is back online through its official accounts. Users who recently connected a wallet on the abnormal site can contact the founder by direct message for assistance.

data.title: Nvidia-Backed Baseten Starts $2 Billion Funding Round at Up to $30 Billion Valuation
data.description: AI inference company Baseten has begun raising $2 billion in a new funding round at a valuation of up to $30 billion, with existing investor Sands Capital expected to lead. According to Odaily, Baseten was founded in 2019 and provides enterprises with a platform to deploy and run AI models. The company raised $1.5 billion in June at a $13 billion valuation. Competitor Fireworks AI raised $1.5 billion in July at a $17.5 billion valuation. Nvidia invested $150 million in Baseten in January.

data.title: Ondo Expands Smart Portfolio Lineup to Solana
data.description: Ondo has expanded its smart portfolio product line to Solana. According to Foresight News, all seven portfolios are now available to eligible investors outside the United States and can be traded through major Solana wallets and apps. Three portfolios use strategies developed for Ondo by BlackRock, while the other four are Ondo-designed on-chain portfolios built around popular market themes, including large-cap technology companies and AI.
